WITH sales_with_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  net_sales,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) as rank
FROM sales_with_returns
ORDER BY rank

WITH sales_lines AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    fsl.net_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as refund_net
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY s.region, fsl.sales_line_id, fsl.net_amount
)
SELECT 
  region,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount - refund_net), 2) as net_sales,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(net_amount - refund_net) DESC) as rank
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY rank

WITH net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_region AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d  ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT 
  region,
  ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) as net_sales,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(net_sales) DESC) as rank
FROM by_region
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY rank
